scope: Support triage only: two disposable identities, consented synthetic order reference and support messages. No PDFs, AI/model invocation or emails. Prior PDF/AI acceptance remains historical.
checks: Support routes require gateway authorization
Ordinary customers cannot inspect the staff queue
Invalid empty selected-PDF scope is rejected
Support sharing needs explicit consent
Support creation does not copy PDFs/history or guessed attachment fields
Structured category and order reference persist with normal priority
Customer cannot choose staff priority
Other customers cannot read a known ticket ID
Other customers cannot change or delete a known ticket ID
Other customers cannot see the owner's support list
Staff sees only explicitly submitted support text
Staff queue only exposes bounded summaries
Staff queue continuation token works
Combined staff filters find the exact synthetic order
Wrong category returns no matching order
Invalid priority filter is rejected
Administrator sees support usage and configured limits
Staff priority is visible to the customer
Customer sees the staff reply and resolved state
Stale customer update cannot overwrite a staff reply
Customer follow-up reopens the request without extending retention
Customer can close the request
Closed request rejects additional customer replies
Deleting a support request requires explicit confirmation
Owner deletion removes that support request
Deleting customer is blocked immediately
Staff cannot inspect or change tickets of a deleting customer
Account deletion purges all owned support rows
Deleting one customer preserves the other customer's request
